svg.title: How a whisper travels
svg.desc: Animated architecture diagram of sending one message in Whisper. 1: the sender's UI shows an optimistic bubble and POSTs to /api/messages/send/:id. The request passes Arcjet (shield, bot detection, rate limit) and protectRoute (JWT cookie) before sendMessage runs. 2: an attached image is uploaded to Cloudinary. 3: the message is saved to MongoDB. 4: Socket.IO emits newMessage to every tab the receiver has open. 5: the receiver's chat appends it and plays a notification sound. 6: the API answers 201 Created and the sender swaps the temporary message for the saved one.
svg.text: REST writes the message, Socket.IO delivers it — one send, end to end.

g.text: — only when an image is attached
